sourceAttempts.method: Current Coosa River Whitewater Map and kayaking page review
sourceAttempts.result: The city identifies the popular seven-mile Jordan Dam-to-downtown corridor, public Corn Creek Park and Gold Star Park exits, Class II features and flow descriptions at 2,000, 4,000, 6,000 and 10,000 cfs.

The outfitter corroborates the seven-mile, 3–4 hour corridor, River Falls, Moccasin Gap, Pipeline, Big House and Wetumpka Falls, with a Class II left channel and Class III right channel at Moccasin Gap.

sourceAttempts.method: Coosa River Whitewater access and trip review
sourceAttempts.result: The trail page confirms below-Jordan-Dam access, the Wetumpka whitewater corridor, paddling demand and public or outfitter access context.
USGS 02411600 is the current stage station at Coosa River at Wetumpka and is used for the selected tailwater and downtown reach.
Selected CoosaRiverPipelineFallsSection.JPG by Mike Cline, a public-domain photograph of the exact Wetumpka Coosa corridor.

Jordan Dam coordinates are published by Alabama Recreation Trails; Corn Creek Park and Gold Star Park are current municipal public park anchors geocoded to their river-side approach. Field confirmation of carry, parking and landing remains a release check.
